title: kate-core: accept any letter case in a modeline flag
summary: kate_bool matches on, off, yes, no, true, and false in either ASCII case. The digits 1 and 0 stay exact. The test goes in the existing modeline tests module.

lane.reason: A local Qwen3.8 coder model with 27B parameters on the owner Mac codes this packet. The change is one file and stays under about 60 lines.

data_contracts.schema_diff_summary: modeline.rs is a private module of document.rs. Its one test module is mod tests. Add the new test function at the end of that module, before its closing brace. Do not write a second mod tests. Replace kate_bool with one if else if chain. if value.eq_ignore_ascii_case("on") || value.eq_ignore_ascii_case("true") || value.eq_ignore_ascii_case("yes") || value == "1" { Some(true) } else if value.eq_ignore_ascii_case("off") || value.eq_ignore_ascii_case("false") || value.eq_ignore_ascii_case("no") || value == "0" { Some(false) } else { None }. Do not nest an if inside an if. Do not fold the case of 1 or 0. Do not touch modeline_ending, set_modeline_rest, trailing_policy, or modeline_overrides. You may update a comment that says the flag words are exact case. The existing tests modeline_maps_the_documented_values and a_modeline_accepts_upper_endings stay green. Do not rewrite their assertions. The test a_modeline_flag_accepts_upper_case uses modeline_overrides. kate: replace-tabs ON; sets indent_with_spaces to Some(true). kate: replace-tabs OFF; sets Some(false). kate: newline-at-eof Yes; sets ensure_trailing_newline to Some(true). kate: replace-tabs maybe; stays None. kate: replace-tabs on; stays Some(true). kate: replace-tabs 1; stays Some(true). Branch from the current tip of main. base_sha records that tip at planning time. If main has moved, use the new tip. Keep the change under about 60 lines. Run the full test module named in the commands, not only the new test.

regression_tests.name: document::modeline::tests::a_modeline_flag_accepts_upper_case
regression_tests.asserts: This test fails on main. replace-tabs ON leaves the flag unset. After the change ON is true and OFF is false. maybe stays unset. A lower on stays true.
